text: 创业板指、科创50均跌超1%，沪指跌0.16%，深成指跌0.78%，AI应用、算力租赁、影视、软件开发等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超3600只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index and STAR 50 both fell over 1%, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.16%, and the Shenzhen Component fell 0.78%, with AI applications, computing power leasing, film/TV, and software development leading declines; over 3,600 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing.
